# Florida Tree Service Match

> Florida Tree Service Match is a free referral service that connects Florida homeowners with up to 3 independent local tree service companies. It is not a contractor and does not perform tree service work. Content cites Florida statutes, city and county tree codes and permit offices, and NOAA/NWS storm records, and labels national estimates as such.

Last updated: 2026-11-21

## Key facts (sourced on the linked pages)
- s. 163.045 F.S.: local governments may not require a notice, permit, fee or mitigation to prune, trim or remove a tree at a single-family residence if the owner has signed documentation from an ISA-certified arborist or Florida-licensed landscape architect that it poses an unacceptable risk.
- St. Augustine: permit for trees 3 inches DBH or larger; Southern Red Cedar protected from 2 feet tall (City of St. Augustine).
- Jacksonville Beach: trees 6 inches DBH or larger are protected; the city says no permit is needed when the owner complies with s. 163.045.
- Fernandina Beach: protected trees are 5 inches DBH or larger; heritage trees are generally native trees 36 inches DBH or more.
- Unincorporated St. Johns County: no tree-removal permit on lots under one acre with an existing home unless a specimen tree or in a conservation area or buffer; Ponte Vedra Zoning District lots need a permit for protected trees.
- Angi 2026 national average tree removal: $750 (range $200-$2,000).
- Tampa requires a permit to remove any tree 5 inches DBH or larger (invasives excluded); 32-inch grand trees need public notice (City of Tampa Natural Resources).
- Winter Park's residential tree removal permit is $35; replacement trees must be Florida #1 grade, at least 3-inch caliper, planted within 30 days (City of Winter Park).

## Guides
- [Do you need a permit to remove a tree in Florida?](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/guides/florida-tree-removal-permit-rules/): Florida's arborist-documentation exemption for single-family homes, and when local tree rules still apply.
- [Tree removal rules in Northeast Florida, city by city (2026)](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/guides/northeast-florida-tree-removal-rules-by-city/): Permit thresholds, protected trees and the arborist exemption in St. Augustine, the beaches, St. Johns and Clay counties, Orange Park and Fernandina Beach.
- [Tree removal rules and costs in Tampa Bay, city by city (2026)](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/guides/tampa-bay-tree-removal-rules-costs/): Protected-tree sizes, permit fees and exemptions in Tampa, St. Pete, Clearwater, Largo, Dunedin and Tarpon Springs, plus 2026 national costs.
- [Tree removal rules and costs around Orlando, city by city (2026)](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/guides/orlando-area-tree-removal-rules-costs/): Permit fees, replacement rules and exemptions in Winter Park, Oviedo, Sanford, Kissimmee, Winter Garden and Lake Mary, plus 2026 national costs.

## Service areas
- [Tree Service in St. Augustine, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/st-augustine/): The City of St. Augustine requires a tree removal permit for any tree 3 inches or larger in diameter at breast height; the city lists the permit at $30 through its Planning and Building Department.
- [Tree Service in St. Augustine Beach, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/st-augustine-beach/): St. Augustine Beach requires a Tree Removal Permit before removing a protected tree, and counts severe pruning of 33 percent or more of the canopy as removal.
- [Tree Service in Ponte Vedra Beach, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/ponte-vedra-beach/): Lots in the Ponte Vedra Zoning District are the exception: removing any protected tree needs a Protected Tree Removal Permit, with a $200 application fee and a site plan.
- [Tree Service in Nocatee, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/nocatee/): Most Nocatee existing-home lots need no county tree permit; HOA manuals such as Crosswater's set their own replacement and street-tree rules.
- [Tree Service in Fruit Cove & St. Johns, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/fruit-cove-st-johns/): In unincorporated St. Johns County, removing a tree on a lot under one acre with an existing home does not need a permit unless it is a specimen tree or sits in a conservation area or buffer.
- [Tree Service in World Golf Village, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/world-golf-village/): In unincorporated St. Johns County, removing a tree on a lot under one acre with an existing home does not need a permit unless it is a specimen tree or sits in a conservation area or buffer.
- [Tree Service in Palm Valley, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/palm-valley/): Most Palm Valley existing-home lots under an acre need no county tree permit, unless the tree is a specimen, the lot is in a conservation buffer, or it falls in the Ponte Vedra Zoning District.
- [Tree Service in Jacksonville Beach, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/jacksonville-beach/): Jacksonville Beach protects any tree 6 inches or more in diameter unless it is specifically listed as unprotected, and a fine can be assessed for removing a protected tree without a permit.
- [Tree Service in Atlantic Beach & Neptune Beach, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/atlantic-beach-neptune-beach/): Atlantic Beach's Chapter 23 requires a tree or vegetation removal permit for regulated trees, with exemptions for trees destroyed in an emergency and for imminent safety hazards confirmed by the administrator.
- [Tree Service in Fleming Island, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/fleming-island/): Unincorporated Clay County's tree-protection article exempts single-family lots of record before January 28, 2003 and single-family lots not in a major subdivision created after that date; confirm with Clay County Zoning.
- [Tree Service in Orange Park, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/orange-park/): The Town of Orange Park sets mitigation for protected trees removed and not replaced: $148 per inch DBH, or $165 per inch for historic protected trees.
- [Tree Service in Fernandina Beach, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/fernandina-beach/): Fernandina Beach protects healthy non-invasive trees 5 inches DBH or larger and requires a removal permit for them.
- [Tree Service in Tampa, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/tampa/): Tampa requires a permit for trees 5 inches DBH and up; grand trees (32 inches+) need public notice.
- [Tree Service in St. Petersburg, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/st-petersburg/): St. Pete protects shade trees from 4 inches DBH; grand trees are 30 inches and up (except laurel oaks).
- [Tree Service in Clearwater, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/clearwater/): Clearwater protects nonhazardous trees 4 inches DBH and up, and palms with 10 feet of clear trunk.
- [Tree Service in Largo, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/largo/): Largo requires a tree permit for trees 4 inches and up and palms over 4.5 feet; dead and invasive removals are free.
- [Tree Service in Dunedin, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/dunedin/): Dunedin tree permits cost $25; grand trees need a permit even to prune.
- [Tree Service in Tarpon Springs, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/tarpon-springs/): Tarpon Springs' staff arborist does hazard inspections for a $50 resident fee.
- [Tree Service in Winter Park, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/winter-park/): Winter Park residential tree permit $35; replacements are 3-inch caliper minimum, planted within 30 days.
- [Tree Service in Oviedo, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/oviedo/): Oviedo requires a permit for canopy trees: $46 per tree plus a $25 tech fee.
- [Tree Service in Sanford, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/sanford/): Single-family arbor permits in Sanford are free; replacement may be required under Schedule J.
- [Tree Service in Kissimmee, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/kissimmee/): Kissimmee handles tree removal requests under the Site Development & Tree Removal permit type.
- [Tree Service in Winter Garden, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/winter-garden/): Winter Garden tree permits need an arborist report for non-invasive trees over 12 inches DBH.
- [Tree Service in Lake Mary, FL](https://colemer.github.io/florida-tree-service-match/tree-service/lake-mary/): Lake Mary allows one tree removal per single-family lot every three years as of right, with conditions.
